Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full service-request payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Report a problem","subtitle":"Choose what you'd like to report","locationText":"Near 123 Main St","requestTypes":[{"id":"pothole","label":"Pothole / road","description":"Damaged road or pavement","icon":"road"},{"id":"streetlight","label":"Streetlight out","description":"Broken or flickering light","icon":"light"},{"id":"graffiti","label":"Graffiti","description":"Vandalism or tagging","icon":"graffiti"},{"id":"trash","label":"Trash / dumping","description":"Missed pickup or illegal dumping","icon":"trash"},{"id":"water","label":"Water / leak","description":"Leak, flooding, or hydrant","icon":"water"},{"id":"facility","label":"Facilities","description":"Building or campus maintenance","icon":"building"}],"submitText":"Start report","submitValue":"I'd like to report a"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): the prompt shown at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Report a problem'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): one short line under the title.
- 'locationText' (string, optional): the place the report is about (e.g. an address or intersection), shown as a context banner above the grid. Include it whenever the location is known.
- 'requestTypes' (array, REQUIRED, at least two objects): the kinds of problem the person can choose from. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'label' (string, short). Optional: 'description' (string, one short line under the label) and 'icon' (string; one of 'road','light','graffiti','trash','water','building','tree','sidewalk','noise','other' — drives the tile icon; defaults to 'other'). Choose request types that fit the agency or campus (e.g. road/light/graffiti/trash/water for a city 311; building/water/light/other for campus facilities).
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Start report'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen request label and id when sending back. Defaults to "I'd like to report a".

Never emit fewer than two request types. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
